title: Haloumi and Quinoa Salad
subtitle: with Marinated Tomatoes and Olives
description: Brimming with greens, protein-rich quinoa and golden slices of haloumi, this speedy salad makes a super-nourishing and super-satisfying bowl.

steps.text: Cook quinoa: Put the quinoa in a sieve, then rinse well and drain (see Kitchen 101). Put the quinoa in a small saucepan with 250ml (1 cup) water, cover and bring to a simmer. Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 12-15 mins until the water is absorbed and the quinoa is tender. Turn off the heat and stand, covered, for 5 mins. Transfer to a large bowl to cool slightly.
Prep ingredients: Meanwhile, cut the tomato into wedges. Trim the beans, then halve on an angle. Halve the olives. Crush 1 garlic clove. Cut the haloumi into 1cm-thick slices.

Marinate tomato: Put the garlic, 1½ tbs olive oil, 3 tsp red wine vinegar and ¾ tsp honey in a bowl, season with salt and pepper and whisk to combine. Add the tomato and toss to coat, then set aside for 10 mins to marinate. Meanwhile, bring a small saucepan of water to the boil. Add the beans and cook for 1-2 mins until tender. Drain.

Pan-fry haloumi: Put the haloumi and 1½ tsp barbecue seasoning in a bowl and toss to coat. Heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the haloumi for 1-2 mins each side until golden. Remove from the pan.
Serve up: Add the tomato, marinating liquid, beans, olives and salad leaves to the quinoa and toss to combine. Season with pepper. Divide the quinoa salad among bowls, top with the haloumi and enjoy!
Kitchen 101: It’s important to rinse the quinoa well to remove the natural coating called saponin, which can make it taste bitter or soapy.
